Waste Not, Want Not

Food For All Africa

Food for All Africa is a registered non-profit organization that operates West Africa’s first and largest food bank in Ghana. Our primary focus is catering to the nutritional needs of vulnerable individuals, including children, youth, the elderly, and persons with disabilities. We also supply food to orphanages, educational institutions, and local communities that rely on donations to sustain their nutritional and livelihood requirements.

Our mission is to eliminate food waste, poverty, food and nutrition insecurity in Ghana.

A Ghana without hunger food waste and poverty

What We Do

Reducing Hunger, Food Waste & Poverty.

We develop impactful programs that tackle hunger-related issues by partnering with individuals and organizations committed to supporting the poor in Ghana and sub-Saharan Africa.

Partner With Food For All Africa

More than 850 million people worldwide are suffering from poverty and hunger, which makes hunger one of the most prevailing issues crippling societies today.  90% of the people suffering from hunger and poverty are in developing countries, which include Ghana.
